full_prompt_en: A lively pen-and-watercolor caricature shows a short, indignant fictional traveler marching along an old stone wall. He carries an oversized brown backpack with a rolled blanket and several dangling pouches, gripping its straps in both hands. His long greenish coat swings around his legs, a bright orange-red scarf falls down the front, and exaggerated pointed brown shoes stride across cracked pavement. The face is deliberately outsized: large round eyes, full flushed cheeks, an upturned blond fringe, and a tight pursed mouth communicate comic determination. The figure occupies the center of a lightly painted square scene, with pale blue-gray masonry behind and irregular cream sidewalk beneath. Loose dark pen contours define the face, straps, shoes, and stone joints; finer crosshatching and short scribbles build rough texture and cast shadows. Transparent watercolor washes vary within each area, giving the coat olive and sage folds, the wall cool gray-blue patches, and the bag warm umber. The scarf is the sharpest color note, drawing the eye through the middle of the figure. The top and side edges fade into generous white paper rather than forming a seamless full-bleed world. Lighting is clear and soft, with small warm highlights on face and shoes and a modest ground shadow. The humor comes from the contrast between purposeful posture and comically burdensome gear, carried by the drawing's nimble line and imperfect wash.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅活泼钢笔水彩漫画描绘矮个子、愤愤不平的虚构旅人沿旧石墙行进。他背着超大的棕包，挂有卷毯和数个摇晃小袋，两手紧抓肩带。长绿调外套绕腿摆动，鲜橙红围巾从胸前垂下，夸张尖头棕鞋跨过开裂铺地。脸被有意画大：圆睁大眼、饱满涨红脸颊、上翘金发刘海和紧抿嘴传达滑稽决心。人物占据轻绘方幅中心，后有浅蓝灰石墙，下有不规则奶油色步道。松动深钢笔轮廓界定脸、肩带、鞋和石缝；较细交叉排线与短乱线建立粗纹和投影。透明水彩罩染在每个区域内部变化，让外套有橄榄与鼠尾草褶皱，墙有冷灰蓝斑，包为暖棕褐。围巾是最锐的色点，把目光拉过人物中央。上缘和侧缘淡入宽阔白纸，而非形成无缝满版世界。光清楚而柔和，脸和鞋有小暖亮，地上有适度投影。幽默来自坚定姿态和滑稽重负装备的对比，由画面轻快线条与不完美罩染承载。
style_prompt_en: Pen-and-watercolor caricature uses lively uneven dark contour, elastic proportions, and transparent color washes on white paper. Fine hatching and quick scribbled strokes add material texture without hiding the broad silhouette. Cool pale blue-gray and cream establish a quiet surround, while olive, umber, warm flesh, and a concentrated orange-red accent gather in the focal form. Washes remain visibly variable, with lighter paper showing through and edges sometimes fading away. Facial or focal details can be enlarged and sharply described while secondary surfaces stay loose. A light ground shadow anchors the figure, and the perimeter opens into white margin instead of full-bleed color. The rhythm alternates brisk diagonal motion with repeated small strap-like and joint-like lines. The result is observant, humorous, and hand-crafted, with color clarifying the gesture rather than overwhelming the drawing.
style_prompt_zh: 钢笔水彩漫画在白纸上使用活泼不均的深轮廓、弹性比例与透明罩染。细排线与快速乱笔添加材质纹理，不遮住宽阔剪影。冷浅蓝灰与奶油建立安静周围，橄榄、棕褐、暖肤色和集中橙红强调聚在焦点形。罩染明显不均，浅纸透出，边缘有时淡去。面部或焦点细节可放大且清楚描述，次要表面保持松动。浅地面影固定形体，外围开放成白边，而非满版颜色。节奏在快速斜向运动与重复小带状、接缝状线之间交替。结果善观察、幽默且手作，颜色澄清动作而不淹没绘画。
theme_en: An indignant fictional traveler marches along a stone wall with an oversized pack
theme_zh: 一位愤愤不平的虚构旅人背着大包沿石墙行进
name: Dave Granlund
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
